data.title: 楪祈 · 街角花店
data.description: 【楪祈 · 街角花店】阳光温暖的街角小花店内，楪祈俯下身子，鼻尖轻轻贴在一束盛开的白色百合花瓣上，粉色的秀发如瀑布般垂落。她转过头向你露出恬静而纯洁的浅笑——「百合花的花语是纯洁与守护。集，我想把这束花买下来，摆在我们的房间里。」
data.promptProse: Inori leans toward upright white lilies to smell them, steadying their wrapping with one hand while the other rests on the flower-shop counter. She turns with a small quiet smile beneath pink-to-orange hair, sleeveless white top, black shorts and red ribbon retaining the outfit. The medium view places leaf-filled bouquets behind the counter. Storefront daylight illuminates pale petals and her cheek, with green reflected shade beneath the flower heads.
